smyx-child-window-climbing-detection-analysis v1.0.0 – Initial release

- Provides real-time AI analysis of fixed camera video in living rooms or child activity areas, detecting if a child is climbing windows, leaning out, or gripping window-sill edges.
- Instantly alerts parents via mobile notifications or triggers audible/visual alarms when dangerous actions are detected.
- Operates 24/7 in high-rise homes, kindergartens, and child activity centers, sending urgent notifications with incident snapshots for immediate response.
- Features AI-based automatic detection of risky behaviors, second-level early warnings, and structured alert reports.
- Supports querying and viewing historical safety reports through cloud API, with strict open-id authentication and privacy compliance.
